attributes.board_name: Illinois Department of Financial and Professional Regulation – Board of Dentistry

rules.accepted_credit_types: Clinical or supportive nonclinical courses from approved sponsors: ADA/NDA and ADA CERP, ADHA/NDHA, approved dental/dental hygiene programs, ADA-recognized specialty organizations, AGD and its approved sponsors, ADSA, accredited colleges, JCAHO hospitals, AHA/ACS, LCME medical schools, AMA/ACCME, government agencies, NBC-approved courses, Division-approved sponsors; correspondence/teaching each max 50%
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE for the first renewal after original issuance.
rules.alternatives: Waiver for good cause (armed forces service, temporary incapacitating illness, temporary undue hardship) requested with the renewal.
rules.audit_note: Certify on the renewal application; keep evidence 5 years after the renewal period; random audits.

topics.who: From the first renewal requiring CE
Renewals on/after Jan 1, 2025: before the first renewal requiring CE, then every six years
Those working with children: mandated reporter training at least every six years; others attest at each renewal (325 ILCS 5/4)
Current BLS for Healthcare Providers (or physician statement of disability)

rules.notes: Dental hygienist licenses expire Sept 30 every 3 years; renewal also requires current BLS for Healthcare Providers (or physician statement of disability).
rules.legal_basis: 68 Ill. Adm. Code 1220.440 and renewal sections of Part 1220; 20 ILCS 2105/2105-15.5, 2105-15.7, 2105-370
